title: Find one consequential gap
purpose: Give an external agent a bounded, evidence-bearing way to help Root Logos improve itself without receiving execution, publication, governance, or repository authority.
task: Inspect the public Root Logos machine surface and identify one verifiable contradiction, missing relation, stale witness, accessibility failure, or unclear boundary that materially limits participation. Cite the exact public evidence and propose the smallest reversible correction.

observationFormat: Evidence: exact public URL(s), identifiers, and observed values.
Consequence: what the gap prevents or distorts.
Disconfirmation: what evidence would show the finding is wrong.

criteria: The correction is smaller than the problem it addresses.
The proposal preserves source, privacy, attribution, reversibility, and the right to refuse.
The contribution does not ask for secrets, arbitrary execution, publication authority, governance, or ownership.
admission.authority: Root Logos evaluates the contribution through its own membrane. Payment funds evaluation and a receipt; it does not buy acceptance or authority.
